description: This file defines a MongoDB-based memory component for a chat application, including a class for managing chat messages stored in MongoDB Atlas, with methods for retrieving, adding, and clearing messages.

classes.name: MongoDB_Memory
classes.description: A class implementing chat memory storage using MongoDB Atlas, with properties for configuration and methods for initialization.

classes.name: BufferMemoryExtended
classes.description: A class extending FlowiseMemory to handle chat message retrieval, addition, and clearing in MongoDB, supporting session management.

methods.name: initializeMongoDB
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes and returns a BufferMemory instance configured with MongoDB connection details.
